Number of full loads = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648 ÷ 1,700 = 648.

The number of full loads is 648.

Number of kilometres left = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648 ÷ 1,700 km = 648.

Thus, one full load is used up completely, and there are 648 kilometres left.
